title: Bar chart
description: Compares values across categories, or across a short run of periods, with one or more series.
x-use-when: Comparing a measure across categories (revenue by rep, tickets by priority) or a short run of periods (revenue by quarter). Use horizontal bars for rankings and long names.
x-dont-use-when: There is only one number (use kpi), the user needs exact values for many records (use table), or there are more than 30 categories (aggregate to top N first).
x-checks: Error when a series has a different number of values than there are categories.
Error when two series share a name.
Warns when percent values look like whole numbers (45 instead of 0.45).
Warns when vertical bars have more than 8 categories or labels longer than 14 characters (use horizontal).
Warns when stacked is true with only one series.

categories.description: Category labels in display order (top to bottom for horizontal bars). Sort rankings largest first; keep periods in time order.

series.description: One entry per measure. Each series has exactly one value per category, in the same order as categories.

name.description: Series name shown in the legend and tooltip, e.g. "Revenue".

values.description: Raw numbers aligned with categories. Use null for a missing value, never 0.

format.description: How values are displayed on the axis and tooltip. percent expects fractions: 0.45 shows as 45%.

orientation.description: vertical for periods and a few short categories; horizontal for rankings, many categories, or long names.

stacked.description: Stack series into one bar per category. Only when the series add up to a meaningful total (new + renewal revenue).
